title: Rinnai — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Rinnai.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Tankless Innovation." Rinnai is the global leader in tankless water heaters — Japanese engineering delivering endless hot water with energy savings. Also makes combination boiler/water heater units.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Tankless water heater installations. Energy-conscious homeowners. Renovation projects upgrading from tank heaters.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Rinnai:

• Endless hot water — never runs out

• Energy savings of 40% vs traditional tank heaters

• Japanese engineering and reliability

• Compact wall-mount saves floor space

• Longest warranties in the tankless market
